plan.subject: Marketing science

queries.query: ("charm pricing" OR "left-digit effect" OR ".99 pricing" OR "psychological pricing") AND (marketing OR consumer OR retail OR pricing OR ecommerce OR "online shopping")
queries.rationale: Catches empirical studies on whether and when price-ending strategies like $9.99 still influence consumer perception and conversion.

queries.query: ("discount depth" OR "promotional discount" OR "price promotion") AND ("brand perception" OR "brand equity" OR "brand trust" OR "premium brand")
queries.rationale: Targets research on how discounts and promotions affect brand image, perceived quality, and long-term value, not just short-term sales.

queries.query: ("ad creative" OR "advertisement effectiveness" OR "advertising appeal") AND (conversion OR "click-through rate" OR "purchase intent" OR "sales lift")
queries.angle: Ad creative elements that drive conversion
queries.rationale: Finds studies isolating specific elements of ad creative (imagery, text, calls-to-action) that are linked to measurable performance outcomes.

queries.query: ("product naming" OR "brand name" OR "product name") AND (memorability OR recall OR "purchase likelihood" OR perceptions)
queries.rationale: Retrieves evidence on how different naming strategies (descriptive, abstract, phonetic) affect consumer memory, attitudes, and choice.

queries.query: ("scarcity cue" OR "limited quantity" OR "limited time offer") AND (conversion OR "purchase decision" OR "checkout" OR "cart abandonment")
queries.rationale: Focuses on applied research testing how scarcity messages (low stock, time limits) influence final purchase decisions and reduce abandonment.

queries.query: ("default option" OR "choice architecture" OR nudging) AND (marketing OR consumer OR ecommerce OR "online retail")
queries.rationale: Captures studies on how setting defaults (e.g., for subscriptions, add-ons) influences consumer choices in online settings.

queries.query: ("social proof" OR "review valence" OR "review helpfulness" OR "user-generated content") AND (conversion OR "purchase behavior" OR ecommerce)
queries.rationale: Targets empirical work on how review characteristics (star rating, volume, text content) quantitatively impact conversion rates.

queries.query: ("free shipping" OR "shipping cost" OR "delivery fee") AND (conversion OR "cart value" OR "purchase incidence")
queries.rationale: Finds research on the conversion impact of shipping offers, thresholds, and how they interact with pricing and cart size.

queries.query: ("landing page" OR "website design") AND (conversion OR "user experience" OR "A/B testing")
queries.rationale: Catches applied studies testing specific landing page elements (headlines, forms, layout) using A/B tests and conversion metrics.

queries.query: ("price framing" OR "partitioned pricing" OR "drip pricing") AND ("perceived cost" OR "transaction utility" OR willingness-to-pay)
queries.rationale: Targets research on how breaking down prices (e.g., product + fees) or framing them (vs. competitor) affects perceived value and conversion.

queries.query: ("personalization" OR "targeted advertising" OR "recommendation system") AND (ecommerce OR "online retail")
queries.rationale: Captures studies measuring the lift in conversion or revenue from personalized ads, emails, or product recommendations.

queries.query: ("visual attention" OR "eye tracking") AND (advertising OR "product page" OR "website")
queries.rationale: Finds eye-tracking and attention studies linking specific design elements to where consumers look and subsequent conversion.

queries.query: ("message framing" OR "gain-loss framing") AND (marketing OR consumer OR advertising)
queries.rationale: Targets research on whether emphasizing gains (save $X) vs. avoiding losses (don't miss out) is more effective in driving action.

queries.query: ("consumer attention" OR "advertising clutter") AND (effectiveness OR recall OR "ad avoidance")
queries.rationale: Catches studies on how ad saturation and competition for attention impact the effectiveness of individual marketing messages.

queries.query: ("subscription model" OR "free trial") AND (adoption OR retention OR "churn prediction")
queries.rationale: Targets empirical work on what drives initial subscription sign-ups, trial conversion, and reduces churn in DTC contexts.

queries.query: "A/B testing" AND (marketing OR ecommerce OR "conversion rate optimization")
queries.rationale: Broad query to capture a wide range of applied marketing science papers that use or evaluate A/B testing methods, ensuring recall safety.

queries.query: ("conversion rate" OR "purchase conversion") AND (ecommerce OR "online retail" OR marketing)
queries.rationale: Broad, high-recall query focusing on the core outcome metric, designed to catch papers on diverse conversion factors not covered by narrower queries.

plan.coverage_notes: Plan focuses on applied, quantitative angles directly relevant to a DTC growth marketer: pricing, promotions, creative, landing pages, and behavioral nudges. It uses Pattern A (specific phenomenon × loose category) for most queries, with two broad recall-safety queries (#16, #17). Deliberately skips brand equity theory, advertising history, media planning, B2B marketing, and pure consumer psychology without performance metrics.

query_results.rationale: Catches empirical studies on whether and when price-ending strategies like $9.99 still influence consumer perception and conversion.
